name: RSI reversion, calm-volatility gated (5m)
rationale: An oversold 5m RSI is only faded when realized volatility is BELOW a ceiling — a calm tape where dislocations are noise that snaps back, not the start of a volatility-driven trend. The gate is the key differentiator from the ADX-gated variant: vol_realized filters on the size of moves, not their directionality. The other side is the noise seller in a quiet book. Edge persists because low-vol regimes are where reversion dominates and momentum is weak. Disconfirmer: exits when RSI recovers above the exit level, or the stop fires if a vol expansion turned the dip into a breakdown.
catalyst: oversold RSI inside a low realized-volatility regime
